verdict.rationale: The evidence shows static API documentation for the Marketing Emails API, with endpoint paths such as GET /marketing/v3/emails and markdown versions of the docs. Nothing shows an interactive API reference, a try-it console, or runnable examples. OpenAPI spec probes also returned 404, so there is no documented spec for interactive tooling either. The axis applies to a SaaS platform with a developer API, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
